newsitem.title: USA: Hilton willing to raise ITT offer.
newsitem.headline: Hilton willing to raise ITT offer.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp said Monday it is willing to offer more than $55 per share for ITT Corp if such an offer is supported by a review of private information.
Announcing an offer of cash and stock valued at about $6.5 billion for ITT's common, Hilton said its proposal was prepared solely on the basis of publicly available data.
"With ITT's cooperation, an ensuing review of private information could result in an even higher offer," Hilton's statement said.

ITT's entertainment business, including Madison Square Garden; the New York Knicks; the New York Rangers and WBIS+, a New York City TV station owned with Dow Jones & Co Inc, as well as ITT World Directories and ITT Educations, would be carefully reviewed as to their long-term strategic fit with the combined company, Hilton said.

"We believe that through the monetization of nonstrategic assets, and a focus on the company's core business lines, we will create even more value for the shareholders of the combined companies," the statement said.
